description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class AbstractComposite within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Validator\Rules\Composite. The class provides a base for composite validation rules that combine multiple Rule instances and validate input based on these rules, using reflection for dynamic instantiation.

classes.name: AbstractComposite
classes.description: An abstract class for composite validation rules that aggregates multiple Rule instances and performs validation using reflection-based instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AbstractComposite with a variable number of Rule objects and stores them in the protected array $rules.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input by dynamically instantiating each rule with its constructor parameters, then applying the composite rule's validation logic.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to specify the class name of the composite rule.
